name: Beta Drugs Ltd
about: Beta Drugs Ltd is engaged in manufacturing of a wide range of oncology (anti-cancer) drugs in India. It has operations in the domestic and export markets.[1]
keyPoints:
Market Position
The company is ranked among the top 10 oncology companies, and many of its key products are ranked among the top 5 in their respective categories. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 37.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.6%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.54 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
